messages:
emma: heads-up, noticing an uptick in truncated streaming responses (clients see partial final token) on prompt route -> v2-edge-proxy canary. Started ~3412350000.

infra-bot: Metric alert: prompt-router.v2-edge-proxy.stream_truncation_rate > 2% for 3m.

ryan: 502s are low, but stream_end events show unexpected EOF. Repro locally with short prompt + streaming enabled. likely header handling or chunked-transfer boundary issue.

katie: Canary is 15% traffic. Can we flip the routing flag off and force all traffic to stable router? Flag: `prompt_routing.v2_edge_experimental`.

emma: I'll trigger the kill-switch. If toggle fails, we need to revert the LB target weights.

incident-bot: Incident created (sev2) — 3412350001. Oncall ryan paged. Runbook: stream-truncation.

emma: curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/v1/flags/prompt_routing.v2_edge_experimental/toggle" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF" -d '{"enabled":false}'

infra-bot: Flag toggle accepted. New flag state: disabled. Propagation to edge proxies ~10-20s.

deploy-bot: Deploy canary for v2-edge-proxy started at 3412349950; weight 15%.

katie: I'm updating LB weights now as a fallback: setting canary weight -> 0% on cluster us-west-2.

emma: katie confirmed. Applying: `kubectl -n prompt-router patch service v2-edge-proxy --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/traffic/canary","value":0}]'`

deploy-bot: LB weights updated: canary 0% -> traffic shifted. Healthchecks on stable route are green.

ryan: Metrics: truncation down from 3.8% -> 0.5% within 45s after shift. Good sign.

support-lead: Support triage: ~9 customers reported blips; 2 enterprise customers (BrightDocs, ComposeAI) reported truncated messages in production, some lost final punctuation/stop sequences. No data corruption. Logged cases: INC-8791, INC-8792.

psm: I'll notify the two accounts and offer a post-incident call. Drafting message now.

qa: I ran the short-seq streaming regression suite against v2-edge-proxy image and reproduced EOF on chunk boundary when gzip header present. Filing as bug: RT-4543.

emma: Good catch. Assign RT-4543 to eng-runtime. For now mitigation: keep flag off and canary drained.

ryan: Handing oncall to katie for monitoring window. Any outstanding deploy jobs?

katie: No further canaries for this service queued. I'll watch the next 30m, confirm no regressions, and then close.

emma: Postmortem action items: (1) revert non-essential header compression changes in v2 build, (2) add streaming regression tests to pre-canary gate, (3) automated flag kill-switch when truncation_rate > 1% for 2m.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=mitigated, mitigation=flag_toggle+lb_weight_zero, next=postmortem, pager=resolved when stable for 30m.

support-lead: Sending customer comms draft to eng/psm for review. Will update cases and attach timeline.

emma: Thanks all. katie please escalate if truncation creeps above baseline. Passing oncall fully to katie.

oncall: acknowledged — monitoring dashboard pinned and alerts silenced for non-critical noise.

katie: 15m check: metrics steady, truncation ~0.4%, stream_success rate restored to baseline. Planning to close incident in 15m unless new signals.

ryan: Filing RCA notes and linking RT-4543. Will follow up on kernel/header handling fix plan.

katie: Closing note: incident will be closed after 30m stable; follow-ups assigned in tracker. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
